info.name: Fintrak API
info.description: Complete API collection for Fintrak financial tracking application including authentication, user transactions (unified expenses/incomes), categories, tags, counterparties with search capabilities, and product endpoints.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Register a new user account
Login user and receive JWT token (automatically saved to environment)

item.description: User authentication endpoints for registration and login

request.description: Get current authenticated user's data
Update current authenticated user's profile information

item.name: Analytics

query.description: Start date of the period (required, YYYY-MM-DD)
End date of the period (required, YYYY-MM-DD)
Number of latest transactions to include (default: 5)

request.description: Get expenses and incomes for a specific time period with totals grouped by category and latest transactions

item.description: Analytics endpoints for financial summaries and insights

item.name: User Transactions

request.description: Search and filter user transactions (both expenses and incomes) with pagination and sorting.
Retrieve a specific user transaction by ID
Check if a bank transaction has a linked user transaction
Create a new user transaction (expense or income). Type, title, amount, currency, category, and date are required.
Update an existing user transaction
Delete a user transaction

item.description: CRUD operations for user transactions (unified expenses and incomes). Each transaction has a type (expense or income), category, and optional counterparty.

item.name: Import

formdata.description: Excel file (.xlsx) containing transactions. Supports BBVA 'Últimos movimientos' format or standard format with columns: date, description, amount, currency (optional), type (optional), category (optional), periodicity (optional)

request.description: Import transactions from Excel file. Automatically detects BBVA format or processes standard format. Negative amounts are treated as expenses, positive as incomes.

response.name: Validation Error
response.body:
{
  "total": 10,
  "imported": 7,
  "expenses": 5,
  "income": 2,
  "format": "Standard",
  "errors": [
    "Row 3: Invalid date format",
    "Row 7: Missing required fields (date, description, amount)",
    "Row 10: Validation failed: amount must be a number"
  ]
}

formdata.description: JSON file containing categories. Expected format: [{"key": "food_dining", "name": "Food & Dining", "color": "#FF6B35", "icon": "restaurant", "keywords": ["restaurant", "food", "dining"]}]

request.description: Import categories from JSON file. Categories with existing keys will be replaced. Supports keywords for automatic transaction categorization.

formdata.description: JSON file containing tags. Expected format: [{"key": "urgent", "name": "Urgent", "color": "#FF0000", "icon": "alert"}]

request.description: Import tags from JSON file. Tags with existing keys will be replaced. Useful for organizing and filtering transactions.

formdata.description: JSON file containing counterparties. Expected format: [{"key": "amazon_es", "name": "Amazon España", "type": {"key": "company", "name": "Empresa"}, "email": "customerservice@amazon.es", "notes": "Tienda online"}]

request.description: Import counterparties from JSON file. Counterparties with existing keys will be replaced. Useful for managing payees and income sources.

Import recurring transactions from JSON file. The file should contain an array of recurring transaction objects with title, currency, category, transactionType, periodicity, and optional minAproxAmount/maxAproxAmount.

formdata.description: JSON file containing crypto assets array. Each asset should have: name (string), code (string), amount (number, optional)

request.description: Import crypto assets from JSON file. Updates existing assets with matching code or creates new ones.

item.description: Import data from external files. Supports Excel transactions (BBVA format), JSON categories with smart keywords, JSON tags, JSON counterparties, and JSON recurring transactions. All imports prevent duplicates by replacing existing items with same keys.

Get a specific recurring transaction by ID

query.description: Filter by counterparty type (company, person, institution, other)
Number of results to return (1-100, default: 50)
Field to sort by (name, type, key, createdAt, updatedAt)

request.description: Search and filter counterparties with pagination and sorting. All filters are optional and can be combined.

item.name: Products

query.description: Compare with snapshot from specified period ago (1d, 7d, 1m, 3m, 1y)

request.description: Retrieve all financial products (deposits, cash accounts, indexed funds) for the authenticated user from the MI service. Optionally compare with previous snapshots using the 'compare' query parameter.
Create or update a daily snapshot of user's products. Only one snapshot per day is stored.
Retrieve historical snapshots of user products within a date range
Retrieve the most recent product snapshot for the authenticated user
Retrieve the product snapshot for a specific date

item.description: Financial products from external MI service

item.name: Bank Integration (TrueLayer)

request.description: Retrieve list of supported Spanish banks (Santander, BBVA) via TrueLayer
Generate TrueLayer authorization URL. The state parameter should contain the user ID for the callback. Redirect user to the returned URL to connect their Santander or BBVA account.
Retrieve all connected banks for the user (Santander, BBVA, etc.). Each connection includes bankId, bankName, and list of connected accounts.
Remove a bank connection. Use the bankId from the connections list (e.g., 'santander', 'bbva').

formdata.description: Custom alias for this bank connection
Image file for bank logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG)

request.description: Update a bank connection's alias or logo. Upload an image file (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG) for the logo. The image will be uploaded to S3 and the URL stored.

⚠️ DEPRECATED: This endpoint has been removed. Bank accounts are now included in the unified GET /api/products endpoint, which returns accounts from all sources (MyInvestor and TrueLayer) in the 'bankAccounts' field.
Get current balance for a specific bank account. The system automatically identifies which bank connection owns this account.
Fetch transactions for a specific bank account. The system automatically identifies which bank connection owns this account.
Sync bank transactions for the authenticated user. Fetches new transactions from all connected banks, stores them locally, stores them locally, and sends push notifications.

item.description: Bank integration via TrueLayer API for open banking. Connect multiple banks (Santander, BBVA) simultaneously. Each bank connection is stored separately, allowing you to fetch accounts and transactions from all connected banks at once.

item.name: Bank Transactions

query.description: Search in description and merchant name (case-insensitive)

request.description: Retrieve all bank transactions stored locally. These are transactions synced from TrueLayer and stored in the database. Supports filtering by account, bank, type, date range, and processed status.
Get aggregated statistics for bank transactions including total credits, debits, and counts.
Retrieve a single bank transaction by its ID.
Update a bank transaction's processed or notified status.
Delete a bank transaction from the local database.
Check if a bank transaction has a linked user transaction. Returns { linked: boolean, transaction: UserTransaction | null }.

Create a user transaction from a bank transaction. The transaction type (expense/income) is automatically determined from the bank transaction type (DEBIT -> expense, CREDIT -> income). Category key is required, counterparty key is optional.

item.description: Manage locally stored bank transactions. These transactions are synced from TrueLayer and stored in MongoDB. You can manually create user transactions (expenses/incomes) from bank transactions using the create-transaction endpoint.

request.description: Access the interactive Swagger API documentation

request.description: Retrieve all crypto assets for the authenticated user
Retrieve a specific crypto asset by ID
Create a new crypto asset

Delete an existing crypto asset

item.name: Upload

formdata.description: Media type: counterparty-logo, profile-picture, receipt, document, or other

request.description: Upload media file to S3. Files are organized by user ID and media type: users/{userId}/{type}/{filename}

item.description: Upload media files to AWS S3 organized by user ID and media type

item.name: Logos

query.description: Search term. "logo png" is appended automatically.

request.description: Search DuckDuckGo images for logos matching the query. Returns up to 12 results with thumbnail and full image URLs.
Downloads an image from the provided URL and uploads it to S3 under users/{userId}/counterparty-logo/. Returns the S3 URL to store as the counterparty logo.

item.description: Logo search and S3 upload endpoints for counterparty logos

item.name: Notifications

request.description: Register a device to receive push notifications. The token is an Expo Push Token obtained from the mobile app. Platform must be 'ios' or 'android'.
Unregister a device from push notifications. The device will no longer receive notifications until re-registered.

item.description: Push notification management for mobile devices. Register devices to receive transaction alerts and other notifications via Expo Push Notifications.

item.name: Cron
Create Daily Snapshots for All Users

header.description: Internal API key for cron jobs

request.description: Internal endpoint to create daily snapshots for all users. Should be called by AWS EventBridge or similar scheduler. Requires API key authentication.

header.description: Internal API key for cron jobs

request.description: Sync bank transactions for all users. Fetches new transactions from TrueLayer, stores them in database, stores transactions, and sends push notifications. Should be called every hour at :05 by AWS EventBridge.

item.description: Scheduled cron jobs for automated tasks
